messages.subject: Factor Scores for Categorial Data
parts:
Dear Yves,

first of all, thank you very much for this great package! A few months ago you wrote, that predict() won't compute valid factor scores if the observed variables are ordinal. My question: Has this issue been fixed yet? And if not: Is there another way to compute factor scores from a given lavaan-object?

Thanks!

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Factor Scores for Categorial Data
parts:
Valid factor scores for ordinal indicators are finally implemented, in the dev version (0.5-14). The computations are still very slow, but I believe they are correct.

To test:

install.packages("lavaan", repos="http://www.da.ugent.be", type="source")
library(lavaan)
HS.model <- ' visual  =~ x1 + x2 + x3
              textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
              speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9 '
fit <- cfa(HS.model, data=HSbinary, ordered=names(HSbinary))
predict(fit)

What is NOT working correctly yet is the multiple group version, where the 'delta' scaling parameters are not all equal to 1. I'm still trying to figure this out.

Yves.
